text.tspan: Baseline and articulated neck on the same recorded session.

svg.text: Same GEM-X joints, same OpenSim IK. Blue: the SOMA head direction (reference); orange: the head direction the model
produces. With the skull welded to the torso (A) the head can only follow the trunk; with the cervical chain (B) it
follows the reference. C: per-frame SO(3) geodesic error after aligning frame 0.
